name: UptimeRobot
whatYouLose: Checks from many regions so you know it is down for everyone, not just your server
A monitor that does not go down with your own infrastructure
prompt:
Build an uptime monitor, an UptimeRobot replacement.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, a worker loop, server-rendered dashboard.
Features:
- Monitors: HTTP(S) with expected status/keyword, TCP port, TLS certificate expiry, heartbeat (cron job pings us).
- Intervals from 30s to 1h; confirm failures with 2 retries before alerting.
- Alerts to email, Slack/Discord webhooks and ntfy.sh on down and recovery.
- Dashboard with response-time sparklines and uptime percentages (24h, 7d, 30d).
- Dockerfile; recommended deployment on a different provider than the services being monitored.
Done when: stopping a local test server triggers a Discord alert and recovery is reported.
notes: The software is easy. The value is independent, multi-region vantage points. Run yours somewhere else.
